projects.name: Real-Time Fraud Detection System
projects.description: End-to-end streaming pipeline that classifies transactions as fraudulent in under 50ms. Built with a fine-tuned gradient-boosted ensemble, served via FastAPI, with Kafka for event streaming and a live monitoring dashboard tracking model drift.

projects.name: LLM-Powered Code Review Agent
projects.description: Autonomous agent that reviews GitHub PRs — detects bugs, style violations, and suggests refactors using a fine-tuned Code LLM with retrieval-augmented context from the repo's history. Integrated as a GitHub Action.

projects.name: Scalable Recommender System
projects.description: Two-tower neural recommender trained on the MovieLens-25M dataset with approximate nearest-neighbour search (FAISS) for sub-10ms inference. Includes an A/B testing harness, feature store, and automated retraining pipeline.
